listing.name: Tekken: Dark Resurrection (PSP) — tkdr-recomp (gasparegas)
listing.summary: The project reports fights at 60 FPS and up to 4×. This original PSP title remains separate from PS3 Dark Resurrection Online. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA ULUS10139 v1.00 ISO or CSO, plus your own decrypted EBOOT.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build natively with CMake, Ninja and SDL2, or use the browser’s on-device translation. Keep both the original ISO and decrypted EBOOT available.

warnings: The project reports fights at 60 FPS and up to 4×. This original PSP title remains separate from PS3 Dark Resurrection Online.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
